messages:
Priya Nair: quick flag 1 interviewers who were promoted to "Senior IC" lost edit access to active scorecards after the role change. They could view but not submit ratings.
Ben Howard: saw 2 tickets about that this morning. They clicked "Submit" and got a permissions error.
Ruth: is this a role mapping bug in the HR sync?
Devon Cole: probably. The HR->ATS SCIM sync maps title->role and we recently added a "Senior" suffix rule. Looks like it mapped them to 'external_consultant' in the ATS by mistake.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-820 ats-role-sync-senior-mapping. Assigned: eng-ops.
Priya Nair: immediate impact: interviewers who couldn't submit ratings left feedback in Slack or email, creating extra work for recruiters to transcribe. Also delays in panel debriefs.
Ben Howard: short-term mitigation: can we add a temporary exception that treats 'Senior IC' as 'Interviewer' in the ATS permission layer?
Devon Cole: yes, we can add a policy override. I can enable it for the affected pool while we fix the sync.
Ruth: long-term fix: update SCIM mapping rules and add test coverage for title normalization. Also add an ops playbook entry for promotion windows to run a post-promo permission check runbook.
Priya Nair: are there logs showing when the mapping changed? We need to know how many people were affected historically.
Devon Cole: config change was deployed yesterday at 03:12 UTC (deploy-hr-sync v2.4.1). I'll pull the audit log and list users remapped.
ops-bot: Update: INC-2026-820 status -> in_progress.
Ben Howard: I'll message the affected interviewers with a workaround: submit feedback as a temp Google Form we own, and we'll import responses into scorecards. Not ideal but faster.
Ruth: also add a note in interviewer onboarding that promotions during active hiring cycles require a quick perms sanity check.
Priya Nair: can engineering also add an alert when interviewer permission changes happen for users with active sessions in the next 7 days? That would prevent silent breakage.
Devon Cole: good call. I'll add an alert: if role change intersects with upcoming scheduled interview within 7d, post to #people-ops-review.
Ben Howard: once the override is live, can we replay the missed submits? We have the Slack threads and forms.
Devon Cole: yes, we'll bulk-import and mark entries with a note "imported from backup". ETA for override + bulk-import: 4 hours. ETA for SCIM rule fix + tests: next sprint.
Priya Nair: thanks. Please update this thread when the override is active so recruiters can stop manual transcriptions.
ops-bot: INC-2026-820 annotated: override_enabled_by=Devon; expected_close=2212349620.
Devon Cole: override enabled, import job queued. Posting follow-up when done.
